title: The wits check 'find the error in his tally' (meant to clear Cal's debt) returned byte-identical failure text on every retry ('The figures are a mess, but an honest one...') with no cost, cap, or acknowledgment of repetition — it never actually worked, and the debt was only ever clearable later once I had 10 gold for a separate paid option.
